lineage.foundation: Reuse exact F124-AN qualified parent tree and original fixed coefficients only by exact immutable identity; do not mutate prior artifacts or treat former developmental science as protected first-use.

source.provenance: Entirely fresh prospective paired graph source, identical original F124-AM first-admitted structural generator and evaluator truth; bind independent seeds, operators and opaque nonces before first use. Do not claim independent unseen protection.
source.corruption: Use original AN three-corruption public-support construction and newly frozen operators/cohorts. Public demo inputs and outputs identical for paired positive/negative graph, no inference access to source operator names, inverse, true class, oracle or pair labels. Any duplicate observations are counted, not silently replaced.
source.source_truth: Evaluator alone restores hidden relation, validates every positive as 1 and negative as 0 with unchanged original graph oracle, and confirms old literal shortcut yields 0.
source.dev_first_use: Exactly once after TRAIN-only candidate/threshold selection; no DEV retuning, re-seeding, selecting after DEV, or reusing consumed DEV as unseen.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: An example-trained relation learner with bounded bit-local nonlinear decision features, calibrated against withheld TRAIN demonstrations, will safely discriminate unfamiliar operator mappings better than prior affine-only RANSAC and abstain rather than produce confident wrong interpretations.
models: bitwise_public_demo_decision_stumps: learn each of sixteen output bits from 22 public support demonstrations using train-only bit tests, polarity and majority prior, no operator catalog
bitwise_depth_two_conditional_votes: two-level per-output-bit public-example decision tree trained on same 22 demos with fixed tie-breaking, no source truth
nearest_support_hamming_vote: k in {1,3} neighbors with output-bit majority and abstention on disagreement, same 22 demos

calibration.ablation: keep all 24 public examples for original AN unchanged comparator; report any support count difference
calibration.select: maximize exact positive-minus-negative TRAIN paired accuracy under zero TRAIN false positives preference, then minimum confident wrong source-only diagnostic, then lower effective operation count; deterministic lexical tie break. Source-only diagnostics never enter the learner.
calibration.forbid: No Feistel/affine operator identity, evaluator inverse or truth in model; no DEV fitting or preview.

controls: evaluator-only correct inverse AG scientific ceiling
Yggdrasil.acceptance: On newly frozen DEV require zero false positives and paired correct > AN original learner; distinguish correct operator recovery, confidently wrong mappings and explicit abstentions, with nontrivial sensitivity on nonlinear Feistel cases; report cost and inherited source-only ceiling honestly.
Yggdrasil.negative_rule: If both confidence and useful positive sensitivity do not hold, retain as negative with separate FP/FN/abstention and learned-vs-oracle diagnostics.

Wingless.hypothesis: Source-blind terminal causal competition using a truly different within-graph single-state ambiguity signal can reject incorrect paths while keeping every long positive already accepted by AN gamma0.
Wingless.input: Source/evaluator alone supplies identical correctly normalized causal graph to all Wingless scoring arms. This is explicitly conditional source-normalized scoring, NOT learned operator competence or end-to-end superiority.
candidates: original AN packed single-state gamma0 control
terminal-sibling-evidence: impose bounded local packed-continuity rank-disagreement penalty from already-available terminal competitors
alternative-target-evidence: compare target and non-target terminal rank using ephemeral same-step candidates, never storing extra per-node states
Wingless.TRAIN_selection: Require every individual AN gamma0 TRAIN long positive preserved; among eligible candidates maximize paired accuracy, minimize FP then measured candidate computation; tie original gamma0.
Wingless.strict_DEV: Every gamma0 accepted individual 13-15-hop positive on fresh DEV still accepted, strictly fewer FP on same 48 paired cases, same packed state cap, and no undeclared extra memory.
Wingless.negatives: No scientific win if FP only drops by rejecting original accepted long positives. Report per-case long-positive identities and FP/FN, do not count different source normalizations as a win.

resources.measure: Same GitHub host per-arm model-only p50 runtime, Python peak transient and explicit extra graph scans/packed candidate inspections on 24 same source-normalized DEV graphs, report operator inference/evaluator overhead separately, no unsupported hardware superiority claims
resources.frozen_budget: Yggdrasil max 16 cells; Wingless one 12-bit state/node; no second persistent graph-state, weight update, extra training/test source or paid model API
resources.qualification: GitHub Windows+Ubuntu focused unit/source isolation checks; authenticate parent run SHA, unchanged parent source and scientific SHA/artifact; reusable proven exact parent foundation plus affected-interface tests, exactly one final Go tests/race/vet/build/isolation regression; qualify before proposing an implementation winner.
